//: Workspace-local probe project (UDG-003 Phase 0). Module resolution walks up from the importing file, so code that imports @colyseus/* must live in the workspace that declares the dependency — a probe under tests/ could never see apps/server/node_modules. It inherits tsconfig.base.json unchanged: strict, skipLibCheck false, and no relaxation here. Output is emitted to probes/dist, which the root dist/ ignore rule already excludes from Git.
